[[Hardcore Mode|{{Color|HardcoreMode}}]] |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]60 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4) |spawned_by = [[Fallen Reaper]] (wave 25 onwards) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Stun}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Slash}}''' - Slashes its axe onto towers, applying a 75% [[Fatigue Debuff]]. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen Soul''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. It can only be summoned by the [[Fallen Reaper]] when it uses its ability from wave 25 onwards. It does not appear naturally. While it has low health and above average speed, its main ability is to slash at towers with its axe. This will apply a 75% [[Fatigue Debuff]] to towers, increasing their firerate and decreasing their DPS, not inclusive of the [[Firerate Bug]]. It also has [[Stun Immunity]], which makes the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] only slow it down instead of completely stopping it and prevents it from being knocked back. ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Soul''' appears to be a knight about the same size as the [[Abnormal]]. Its entire body has a dark, reflective complexion. It has black armor that has a purple gem at the front and skull shoulder-pads that have purple eyes, similar to the [[Fallen Hero (Legacy)|Fallen Hero]]. Its helmet has black horns. It wields an axe on its right arm. This axe is held upside down, similar to the [[Fallen Swordmaster]]. ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Invisible''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *As this enemy is decently fast but weak, Level 3 [[Military Base]]s can deal with these quickly. **The [[Humvee 2]] and [[Humvee 3]] can instantly kill the '''Fallen Soul''' by colliding with it. **However, they might come in swarms from the [[Fallen Reaper]], so prepare any high DPS towers such as the [[Minigunner]]. *It is recommended to place your towers away from the path to prevent the '''Fallen Soul''' from attacking and debuffing them. *Because this spawns along with the minions of the [[Fallen Reaper]], it will be paired up with [[Invisible]]s, [[Hefty|Hefties]] and [[Fallen]]s. Make sure your towers have hidden detection to deal with the [[Invisible]]s, and that your DPS is high enough to deal with the [[Hefty|Hefties]] and [[Fallen]]s. *A [[Commander]] should be placed to boost the firerate of nearby towers, both passively and with its ''Call to Arms''. **If any towers are hit by the '''Fallen Soul''', the [[Commander]] can mitigate some of the effects. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyFallenSoul.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexLegacyFallenSoul.png|'''Fallen Soul''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Unlike the [[Soul]] and [[Soul Boss]], this is not a hidden or ghost enemy. *The helmet worn by the '''Fallen Soul''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|335080498|Winged Helm of the Redcliff Elite}} hat from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Fallen Soul''' added. *'''23 May 2023''' - [[v1.7.3]]a **[[Energy Immunity]] replaced with [[Stun Immunity]]. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **{{Bug}} Has no attack animation in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **No longer copi

It is a stronger version of the [[Fallen]]. It has a decent amount of health and a rather fast speed. The '''Corrupted Fallen''' also has the [[Health Regen]] attribute, meaning it regenerates 2% of its max health every two seconds. The '''Corrupted Fallen''' can be spawned by the [[Fallen King]] with its ''Summon'' ability. The [[Awakened Fallen King]] was previously able to summon it using its ''Army of Chaos'' ability. ==Logbook Description== "''Corrupted Fallen were both the King's and Queen's personal servants. They stood up closest to her during the sacrifice and witnessed her final moments. The corruption crawls across their bodies, slowly consuming them as time moves on. It doesn't seem that they are bothered by this, but regular Fallen tend to stay away from them.''" ==Appearance== The '''Corrupted Fallen''' is a corrupted version of the [[Fallen]]. It has black skin. It wears a white blindfold and appears to be crying behind it. It has multiple blue spikes on its on its body. It has two arm-bands with chains attached to it. ==Strategy== *The '''Corrupted Fallen''' is quite a step-up compared to its non-corrupted counterpart, the [[Fallen]]. While not having much of a step-up in HP, it spawns with the [[Health Regen]] attribute. This means that it should not be left on low health. Instead, it should be dealt with as soon as possible. **Applying high DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Turret]] can take it out with ease, as well as clearing out hordes of '''Corrupted Fallens'''. **The [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Mercenary Base]] can also be useful at boosting your towers. *Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful at clearing out the hordes of '''Corrupted Fallens''' that appear later on. *Because of its high speed, slowing towers such as the [[Cryomancer]], [[Tesla]] and [[Freezer]] can be used to negate their speed. Though since the '''Corrupted Fallen''' does not have any immunities, any tower can be used to slow it down. *If any '''Corrupted Fallens''' leak, the [[Military Base]] can be used to catch any off-guard. It is the second [[Flying]] enemy that appears in that mode, having higher health than the [[Fallen Seraph]] with the same speed. Additionally, it has [[Health Regen]], which causes it to regenerate 2% of its health every 2 seconds. ==Logbook Description== "''Fallen Angels were the kingdom's most devoted followers, blessed by Two X himself for their unwavering faith. They served as spiritual guardians, their presence bringing comfort to all who saw them. However, the Queen's sacrifice corrupted their blessings and tarnished their purity. As the curse consumed them, it became a symbol that their kingdom truly died.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Angel''' is an angel, hovering above the ground using its black wings. It wears blue armor which consists of a helmet, shoulder-pads, chestplate, leggings, shoes and gloves. It has a few crystals on its helmet. Above its head, it has a black halo. It has a hole in the middle of its torso. ==Strategy== *As the '''Fallen Angel''' is a [[Flying]] enemy, the number of towers that can target it is limited. **DPS towers that have flying detection, such as the [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are the best options against it. **The [[UAV]] can be used to give your towers flying detection, making the '''Fallen Angels''' quite easy to deal with. *Area of effect towers with flying detection, like the [[Mortar]], [[Tesla]] or [[Spotlight Tech]], can be useful at dealing with these, though due to this enemy's high health such towers may not be capable of killing this enemy on their own. **The [[Tesla]] can also be useful at slowing them down, giving your towers more time to kill them. *While the '''Fallen Angel''' does not have any immunities, it gains an immunity to being knocked back which is given by default to any [[Flying]] enemy. **This means that towers like the [[DJ Booth]], [[Brawler]] or [[Warlock]] are fully or partially unable to stall it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FallenAngelFly.gif|Flying animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenAngelStun.gif|Stun animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FallenAngel.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenAngel.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}}

The stun lasts for 3-4 seconds. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen Guardian''' is a large guardian [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode. Although it could not spawn naturally in [[The Classic Event]], the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] could summon the '''Fallen Guardian''' during ''Rage Mode''. The '''Fallen Guardian''' always spawns just before the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] and [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] (it also used to appear before the [[Nuclear Fallen King]] spawns). It also appears when the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] (and formerly the [[Nuclear Fallen King]]) summons them during ''Rage Mode''. It also appeared in the legacy [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] and [[The Classic Event]] before its removal. The '''Fallen Guardian''' is an extremely difficult enemy to defeat due to its high health (far higher than the [[Summoner Boss]] and [[Slow King (Legacy)|Slow King]]) and below average walkspeed. Additionally, it has a defense of 80%, meaning that the damage capabilities of most towers are reduced drastically. On top of that, the '''Fallen Guardian''' has the ability to thrust its spear at towers, stunning them for a period of time. The '''Fallen Guardian''' is replaced by the [[Nuclear Guardian]] in [[Polluted Wasteland II]], the [[Cavalry]] in [[Badlands II]] and the [[Minigunner (Pizza Party)|Minigunner]] in [[Pizza Party]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The current '''Fallen Guardian''' is similar to its original version, except it dominus is now dark turquoise. It wore dark turquoise granite armor, which comprised of armbands, knee-pads, sleeves and chestplate. It had black granite gloves, its torso was dark turquoise granite, and it wielded a spear with purple halos near the head. It also wore a black marble dominus. On its dominus, there were parts which were neon purple. Purple smoke was emitted from their torso. }} ==Strategy== *Deal with the '''Fallen Guardian''' before moving on to the major boss that it spawns in front of.
